feel_targets.hazard_readability: A player should see a warning cell before it becomes lethal.
feel_targets.death_clarity: The final hit should be explainable from visible state.
feel_targets.module_identity: Each active module should noticeably change at least one run decision.
feel_targets.suffering_quality: Failure should feel harsh but learnable, not random.

cp5_balance_changes: Allowed movement into a vacating tail cell when the snake is not growing.
Kept active hazards lethal but shield-absorbable.
Kept rewards short-term so CP5 does not become a full upgrade tree.
